items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Cecilia kind of had books like that, but just for piano, you know. And boy she could play some piano.

ctx.x: They didn't play them all, just some of them.

I catch one band maybe play one or two of them, and the other band maybe play two or three of them. I used to study them books. Cecilia kind of had books like that, but just for piano, you know. And boy she could play some piano. She learned that in England. And she finished college over there. She come over here and went to Boston Conservatory. Studied all over again and learned them books. And threw them in the wash shed, you know. In the wash house. They had a regular wash house. They had a bell from his house…
A couple ways in line. A couple ways in line. A couple ways in line.
